explication: This repository is a GitHub issue and feedback automation service, not the Kiro product source. Its principal workflow starts from an issue event, fetches issue context, checks semantic duplicates, classifies non-duplicates with Bedrock, applies labels, and posts an acknowledgment. Separate lifecycle jobs close unresolved duplicates or stale issues, while comment events trigger spam detection. The sampled code clearly shows GitHub and Bedrock integrations, retry handling, and workflow summaries; some workflow-to-script wiring is inferred from the repository layout.
